Confirmed Shikinaisha that no Engishiki list names

A confirmed Shikinaisha is a shrine confidently identified as one of the 927 register entries (unlike a Ronsha, a disputed candidate). 149 carry the confirmed class yet appear on no list. They fall into three kinds, diagnosed below:
• 48 name collisions — a separate item, already named by a list, carries the same ja name. That is a collision, not a proof of identity: shrine names repeat heavily (杉山神社 alone accounts for several of these), so a shared name inside one list does not make two items the same shrine. → a lead to check, not a link/merge queue.
• 0 Kokugakuin-id disagreements — the item shares a Kokugakuin database id with a differently-named entry, and/or that id is claimed by several shrines. This is jawiki and the Kokugakuin database disagreeing on which modern shrine is the 927 entry — do NOT blind-merge these; they need an identification call.
• 101 no twin — no entry shares its id or name: a mis-tagged modern shrine, or a genuine entry the lists are missing.
Report only — nothing here is edited on Wikidata.
